"""Collect the V1-final independent evidence ledger into v1-final-evidence.json (never overwrites)."""

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = ART.parents[1]
OUT = ART / "v1-final-evidence.json"
RECORDS = ["v1-final-adv-target-pytest", "v1-final-adv-target-uv", "v1-final-adv-mutations-37", "v1-final-adv-g2",
           "v1-final-adv-static", "v1-final-adv-ruff-product"]
OWN = ["v1-final-adv-record.py", "v1-final-adv-mutants.py", "v1-final-adv-cli-probes.py", "v1-final-adv-budget.py",
       "v1-final-adv-negative-path.py", "v1-final-adv-collect.py"]


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> int:
    if OUT.exists():
        print("refusing to overwrite", OUT, file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    manifest = json.loads((ART / "final-candidate-files.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    current = {f: sha(ROOT / f) for f in manifest["files"]}
    runs = {}
    for label in RECORDS:
        meta = json.loads((ART / f"{label}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        runs[label] = {k: meta[k] for k in ("command", "cwd", "started", "ended", "exit_code", "output_file",
                                            "output_sha256", "files_unchanged")}
    mutants = json.loads((ART / "v1-final-adv-mutants.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cli = json.loads((ART / "v1-final-adv-cli-probes.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    neg = json.loads((ART / "v1-final-adv-negative-path.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    ledger = {
        "verifier": "Claude V1 (real tool execution, same-UID local review; not an OS/P17 receipt)",
        "collected": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "head": manifest["head"],
        "candidate_manifest": manifest["files"],
        "candidate_current_sha256": current,
        "candidate_matches_manifest": current == manifest["files"],
        "runs": runs,
        "mutants": {"total": len(mutants["results"]), "survived": mutants["survived"], "unexpected": mutants["unexpected"],
                    "product_unchanged": mutants["product_unchanged"],
                    "per_mutant": [{k: r[k] for k in ("name", "status", "exit_code", "failed_count", "summary")} for r in mutants["results"]]},
        "cli_probes": {"total": cli["total"], "mismatches": cli["mismatches"]},
        "negative_path_probes": {"total": neg["total"], "mismatches": neg["mismatches"]},
        "budget_log": "v1-final-adv-budget.log",
        "retries": [{"what": "v1-final-adv-negative-path.py attempt 1", "cause": "own harness bug: sub-directory not created before write",
                     "log": "v1-final-adv-negative-path-attempt1-failed.log", "product_related": False}],
        "own_code_sha256": {name: sha(ART / name) for name in OWN},
        "not_run": ["remote CI / merge / push", "live portal, DB, messaging, browser", "HS-00.03 homoglyphs (separated)",
                    "HS-00.04 workflow semantics (separated)", "HS-00.05 pre-step environment (separated)"],
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: ledger[k] for k in ("candidate_matches_manifest", "mutants", "cli_probes", "negative_path_probes")}, ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
